candidates.trace: draw checks the replay and source-open conditions, computes conserved source and holding volumes, writes both volume fields, and only then performs checked_add on the holding contaminant load. Overflow returns InsufficientWater before inserting a receipt, leaving the two volume writes in the in-memory model.
candidates.conditional_counterexample: Symbolically start a new model with source volume 2, draw 1 with load u64::MAX, then draw 1 with load 1 under a different request ID. The first addition fits; on the second, source and holding volumes are assigned 0 and 2 before u64::MAX + 1 fails. The load remains u64::MAX and the second receipt is absent. This is a constructed API case, not an executed model, generated fixture, or observed failure.
candidates.caller_evidence: At the pinned revision, exact-spelling tracked search found this owner and one direct use in the investigation evaluation report source inside its cfg(test) module. That source uses small fixed volumes, load 12000000, cook fraction 1/10000 and split 1/2. The source assertions were not run and do not establish runtime behavior; exact spelling does not exclude aliases, external users or indirect calls.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: The shared conserved_collection helper itself checks positive amount, source availability and destination addition before returning new values. Production material/collection APIs have separate authority and are not shown to call this model. No native transaction, persisted volume, actual product incident or exploit is claimed. The same model also has unchecked transfer, cooking and splitting arithmetic and a cooking denominator; their actual supported input policy remains open.
candidates.connected_repair: If the model remains a supported reusable contract, compute every fallible result before assigning state or otherwise make error returns atomic, and define/validate fraction denominators, representable arithmetic and overflow policy across draw, transfer, cook, split and consume. Keep exact replay/collision, conservation and distinction from production material authority. Reconcile PL13-215 and other model/consumer aliases before choosing the shared remedy.
candidates.later_acceptance: Only after separate authorization for implementation and product validation, cover overflow after a valid prior draw, no state or receipt changes on error, zero denominators, representable fractional splits, exact replay and the intended isolated caller bounds.
